name: lightbox
title: Lightbox
description: A UI SDK Dialog that shows one image of a set: previous and next (buttons and arrow keys), a counter, the caption, an open-original link and fit or actual size. Dark variants follow the theme with no flash; agents get next, previous and goTo.
docs: Pass `items` ({ id, src, srcDark?, alt, name?, href? }) and control `open`/`onOpenChange` and `index`/`onIndexChange`, or put a `DialogTrigger` inside as children. `srcDark` is rendered next to `src` and CSS shows it under `.dark` or the system dark preference (unless `<html>` opts into light), so there is no flash. Focus returns to the trigger, or to whatever was focused when it opened; pass `finalFocus` to override. The dialog is sized in % of the top layer, never viewport units. Labels are English and overridable through `labels`. Agents see `Image viewer` with `next`, `previous` and `goTo(index)` (0-based).
